jobs.title: Traineeship 'Het Rail Starterstraject' werkvoorbereider & engineer
jobs.description:
Traineeship 'Het Rail Starterstraject' werkvoorbereider \& engineer voor zijinstromers

**Kickstart een carrière met impact**

Je bent toe aan iets nieuws. Iets anders. Iets dat ertoe doet. Een nieuwe uitdaging en een nieuwe carrière waar je echt een positief verschil mee kunt maken. Dit is die kans. In het traineeship Het Rail Starterstraject werk je mee aan projecten die elke dag meer dan een miljoen reizigers raken, van onderhoud tot vernieuwing van het spoor.

Niet zo technisch, of geen ster in rekenen? Geen zorgen. Technische vaardigheden kun je gewoon leren, met inhoudelijke begeleiding van de mentoren van De Nieuwe Ingenieurs, Railcenter, Hogescholen en je toekomstige werkgever. Het belangrijkste is dat je zin hebt om iets nieuws aan te pakken en je carrière een kickstart te geven.

**Je hoeft je leven niet op pauze te zetten**

* Gelijk aan het werk: Start direct in een startersfunctie in de railsector, zoals engineer of werkvoorbereider.
* Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden: Met o.a. een salarisindicatie tot wel €3\.100, zeven vakantieweken per jaar en een mobiliteitsbudget van €650 per maand voor bijvoorbeeld een auto.
* Leren on the job: Alles wat je moet weten, leer je terwijl je werkt en tijdens de tweewekelijkse lesdag bij een hogeschool, aanvullende lessen bij Railcenter in Amersfoort.
* Betrokken mentoren: Met oprechte betrokkenheid zorgen we er samen met jou voor dat je het traject succesvol afrondt.
* Hbo\-erkend: Na twee jaar heb je een microcredential op hbo\-niveau.
* Doorgroeimogelijkheden: Je doet ruim werkervaring op zodat je na afronding van Het Rail Starterstraject stappen in de railsector kunt maken.

*Wij zijn De Nieuwe Ingenieurs*

Een club mensen die zich afzet tegen het onterechte stigma over de techniek. Wij geloven namelijk dat iedereen kan slagen in deze sector. Of je nu jong of oud bent, ervaring hebt of net begint: wij zijn hier om te laten zien dat jij het in onze mooie wereld kan gaan maken!

Aanmelden kan via deze vacature of: www.denieuweingenieurs.nl

**Startdatum traject: november 2026**  
Aanmelden kan tot en met 23 oktober 2026\.

* Hogeschool Rotterdam
* Hogeschool Utrecht
* Fontys Eindhoven

Soort dienstverband: Fulltime

Salaris: Tot €3\.100,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Auto van de zaak
* Bedrijfsopleiding
* Dienstreizen vergoeding
* Extra vakantiedagen
* Flexibele werkuren
* Pensioen
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Telefoon van de zaak
* Werk vanuit huis

Opleiding:

* HAVO (Vereist)

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Licentie/certificaat:

* MBO4\-diploma of minimaal je havo\-diploma (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in Rotterdam

jobs.title: Sales Engineer Solar PV
jobs.description:
**Location:** Dubai, covering the complete UAE \| **Type:** Full\-time \| **Package:** Competitive salary, commission and car allowance

**The role**  
You will grow our Solar PV business under Shams Dubai and other UAE utility schemes. You will own the sale from first meeting to signed contract.

**Key responsibilities**

* Find and close rooftop, carport and ground\-mounted PV opportunities across residential, commercial, industrial, hospitality and education sectors.
* Carry out site visits and assess roof space, loads and consumption from DEWA bills.
* Prepare techno\-commercial proposals with our design team, including system sizing, ROI and payback analysis.
* Guide clients through the DEWA approval process, and ADDC/AADC/SEWA where relevant.
* Build relationships with developers, consultants, facility managers and EPC contractors.
* Maintain an active CRM pipeline and meet monthly and annual revenue targets.
* Cross\-sell our solar hot water and heat pump solutions where there is a fit.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Renewable Energy Engineering.
* At least 3 years of solar PV sales experience in the UAE.
* DEWA Shams certification is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of on\-grid, off\-grid and hybrid systems, inverters and net metering.
* Strong commercial skills, including negotiation, presentation and closing.
* Valid UAE driving license (mandatory).
* Fluent English. Arabic is a plus.

Pay: AED2,707\.00 \- AED9,447\.25 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Integration Engineer MuleSoft & Azure
jobs.description:
Contract:
12 months (subject to extension).
Location:
Zuid-Holland, Netherlands.
Salary:
Not a constraint for the right candidate!
Experience:
8-10 years.
Hybrid:
2 days Work from Home 3 days Work from Office

Your Profile & DNA:

We are looking for an Integration Engineer who can keep our substantial MuleSoft API landscape running and evolving while helping us build the future on Azure Functions. Our strategy is to gradually move away from MuleSoft, and in this role you support the existing platform and bring the Azure expertise needed to guide that transition. In the short term you complete the MuleSoft migration to the new Java version and support the Trade Recommendation Gateway, which streams Bloomberg and FlexTrade trade data to our data scientists. You also contribute to the design and pilot of Python based APIs within the department and help prepare a migration proposal together with the API Platform team. You work closely with data scientists, the API Platform team and other engineering colleagues, and your input helps shape how integrations are built here for years to come. There is also room to explore how this migration could serve as a use case for our Agentic Development Workflow.

Roles & Responsibilities

Maintain and further develop the existing MuleSoft API landscape
Complete the migration of MuleSoft to the new Java version
Support and further develop the Trade Recommendation Gateway, the Bloomberg and FlexTrade trade data stream for data scientists
Troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production MuleSoft integrations
Design, build and pilot Python based APIs within the department
Perform minor maintenance on existing APIs and integrations
Prepare a migration proposal for moving integrations from MuleSoft to Azure Functions, in consultation with the API Platform team
Bring Azure expertise into the team to help guide the transition away from MuleSoft
Contribute technical input to explore whether the migration is a suitable use case for the Agentic Development Workflow
Collaborate with data scientists on the requirements and reliability of the trade data stream
Document integration designs, migration decisions and operational procedures
Safeguard performance, security and stability of the API landscape during the transition

Qualification & Experience

A Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.
Several years of hands-on experience with MuleSoft API development and maintenance
Experience with Java, including migrating applications between Java versions
Practical experience with Azure, particularly Azure Functions
Experience with Python for API development
Affinity with financial trade data or market data streams (e.g. Bloomberg, FlexTrade) is a strong plus
Solid understanding of API design, integration patterns and data pipelines
Experience preparing or contributing to migration proposals or technical roadmaps
Ability to work independently within a complex, mission critical API landscape
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Available 3 days per week on-site in Zuid-Holland

Nice-to-haves

MuleSoft certification (e.g. MuleSoft Certified Developer)
Microsoft Azure certification
Experience in the financial services or asset management sector
Familiarity with agentic development workflows or AI assisted development tooling

COMPETENCIES

Strong stakeholder management across data science, engineering and platform teams
Clear and proactive communication
Strong analytical skills
Comfortable working in an Agile / DevOps way of working
Sense of ownership over the systems you maintain and build
Proactive attitude in identifying and resolving risks during migration
Structured and methodical way of working
Pragmatic, solution oriented mindset in a landscape that is being modernized step by step

What do we offer?

If your profile matches the job requirement and you are interested to be presented to our clients, then please apply and don’t forget to attach your updated CV in line with the JD!
This position is for 1 year with possibility of extension. We offer competitive Gross Salary in line with the market standard.
Besides that, we offer following benefits, such as:
20 days of holiday per year
Encourage Personal Development - Certification (Certification Charges reimbursed)
Income Tax Return Filing
We provide Visa Sponsorship for Candidate & Dependants
Possibility of bonus

Who we are:

A2G Consulting also known as "A2G Technologies" is one of the fastest growing staffing companies in North Brabant region, Netherlands. We cater to Asia and Europe market focusing on high tech & non-high-tech clientele; headquartered in Eindhoven, Netherlands with a branch office in India (Bangalore & Pune) & Dubai. We successfully find a candidate and ensure that they get opportunities in line with their aspirations. We offer visa sponsorship for local & international candidates for career-enhancing opportunities. We strongly believe in equal opportunities and hence have a pool of resources with diversified ethnicity.
You will be deployed and work at one of our client sites.

Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About The Role

As a Software Developer in Test, you will join one of several high-impact teams of QA professionals. You will work on a variety of Veeam products and features, helping us shape the quality of solutions used by companies around the world. During the hiring process, we’ll match your interests and experience with the team and project where you can make the greatest impact.

What You'll Do

Develop and maintain automated tests for Veeam products
Collaborate across the software development team
Enhance frameworks and modules for automated testing
Contribute to test design and implementation
Analyze product source code
Support internal automated testing systems
Build and manage testing infrastructure
Analyze test results, and maintain defects database

Technologies You'll Work With

C# (.Net 8, .Net 10), PowerShell
GitLab, Azure Devops, TeamCity
TestRail

What You'll Bring

From at least 1 year of experience (junior level) up to 3+ years (middle/senior level) in commercial product testing, test automation, or software development; OR practical hands-on coding experience, without a need for testing expertise but with a strong interest in the testing domain (for junior candidates)
Programming experience in C#
Experience with Windows and/or Linux environments
A strong desire to write high-quality code and develop your skills in programming
An open mind, common sense, clear logical thinking, and a lively, analytical mindset - you enjoy analyzing and understanding how things work

Bonus Skills

C#/.NET Framework and Test Automation: LINQ, NUnit, Selenium WebDriver, testing RESTful APIs using HttpClient
Experience with PowerShell
Experience with Git

Cloud platforms experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

24 annual vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
Private medical, dental, and optical insurance for employees and dependents
Life and disability insurance worth 2x gross annual salary
Monthly meal card with €10.46 per working day
Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning
